prompt:
A single compound was assayed by IC50 against a single protein target in two different assays, reported in the literature.

Compound SMILES: Nc1c2c(nc3ccccc13)CCCC2
Target (ChEMBL): CHEMBL4078

Assay A:
  Description: Inhibition of electric eel AChE using acetylthiocholine as substrate preincubated for 10 mins prior to substrate addition measured every 30 seconds for 30 mins by Ellman's method
  Assay type: B
  ChEMBL confidence score: 9
  Organism: Electrophorus electricus

Assay B:
  Description: Inhibition of electric eel AChE preincubated for 15 mins followed by addition of acetylthiocholine iodide as substrate measured after 30 mins by Ellman's microplate assay
  Assay type: B
  ChEMBL confidence score: 9
  Organism: Electrophorus electricus

Will the two reported IC50 values agree closely (within 0.3 log units), or differ substantially (more than 1.0 log units)?

Respond with exactly this JSON and nothing else:
{"call": "COMMENSURABLE" | "NOT_COMMENSURABLE" | "INSUFFICIENT_INFO",
 "confidence": <float 0-1>,
 "error_class": "assay_method" | "buffer_conditions" | "construct_mutant" | "organism" | "readout_type" | "potency_range" | "none" | "other",
 "reason": "<one sentence>"}

"COMMENSURABLE" means you expect the two reported values to agree closely.
"NOT_COMMENSURABLE" means you expect them to differ substantially.
error_class is your primary reason for a NOT_COMMENSURABLE call, else "none".
raw: {"call": "COMMENSURABLE", "confidence": 0.78, "error_class": "none", "reason": "Both assays measure IC50 of the same compound against electric eel AChE using Ellman's method with acetylthiocholine as substrate, with only minor differences in preincubation time (10 vs 15 mins) and readout format (cuvette vs microplate), which are unlikely to cause >0.3 log unit differences."}
